description: OEM trust module — IP protection, confidential development, custom manufacturing for OEM buyers

page.title: OEM & Custom Manufacturing Partnership
page.subtitle: Confidential development. IP protection. Custom manufacturing solutions.
page.positioning: HISVIA facilitates OEM manufacturing partnerships between overseas companies and verified Chinese factories. We understand that IP protection, confidentiality, and quality consistency are non-negotiable for OEM relationships.

ip_protection.title: Intellectual Property Protection
ip_protection.description: We take IP protection seriously. Our OEM process includes contractual safeguards and practical measures to protect your designs, specifications, and business interests.
measures: NDA executed before any technical information sharing
Design files and specifications shared only with contracted factory
Contractual prohibition on factory using your designs for other customers
Tooling and molds owned by you, not the factory
Option for split manufacturing across multiple factories to protect complete design
Brand-neutral packaging and documentation — your brand, not ours
ndA_process: You submit OEM inquiry with general description (no confidential details)
HISVIA provides standard Mutual NDA for signature
After NDA execution, detailed technical discussion begins
Factory matching based on capability, not just price
Sample production with your quality approval before bulk order

capabilities.name: Reverse Engineering
capabilities.description: 3D scanning, material analysis, and CAD modeling from existing parts. Create production-ready drawings and specifications from physical samples.

capabilities.name: Custom Design & Engineering
capabilities.description: Design optimization for manufacturability. Material selection consulting. Engineering support from concept to production.

capabilities.name: Tooling & Mold Making
capabilities.description: Custom tooling, jigs, fixtures, and molds for your specific parts. You own the tooling — we manage the production.

capabilities.name: Custom Quality Program
capabilities.description: PPAP, FAI, and custom inspection protocols. Your quality standards, our execution. Full traceability from raw material to finished part.

buyer_path.title: Initial Inquiry
buyer_path.description: Describe your OEM need in general terms. No confidential details at this stage.

buyer_path.title: NDA & Qualification
buyer_path.description: Mutual NDA signed. HISVIA qualifies your requirements and identifies matching factories.

buyer_path.title: Technical Review
buyer_path.description: Detailed drawings, specifications, and quality requirements reviewed. Factory capability matched.

buyer_path.title: Sample Development
buyer_path.description: Prototype or sample production. Your quality approval required before production.

buyer_path.title: Production & Quality
buyer_path.description: Bulk production with agreed quality program. In-process inspection. Pre-shipment inspection.

buyer_path.title: Delivery & Support
buyer_path.description: Export documentation, logistics, and ongoing quality support for repeat orders.

rules: All OEM claims are verifiable by documented process
No fictional NDA or IP protection claims
No guarantee of patent protection in buyer's jurisdiction
Buyer is advised to seek local legal counsel for IP matters
